# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/vercel
# args: 
Vercel CLI 59.25.0 (Node.js 22.17.0)

  ▲ vercel project [command]

  Manage your Vercel projects                                                   

  Commands:

  add             name             Add a new project                    
  access-summary  [name]           Show member counts by team role for  
                                   project access (requires access      
                                   groups entitlement)                  
  checks          [name]           List, add, or remove deployment      
                                   checks for a project (GET/POST/DELETE
                                   /v2/projects/.../checks)             
  inspect         [name]           Displays information related to a    
                                   project                              
  list                             Show all projects in the selected    
                                   scope (default)                      
  members         [name]           List, add, or remove project members 
                                   for a project                        
  access-groups   [name]           List access groups for a project     
  protection      [action] [name]  Show or toggle deployment protection 
                                   settings for a project               
  web-analytics   [action] [name]  Enable or disable Web Analytics for a
                                   project                              
  speed-insights  [action] [name]  Enable or disable Speed Insights for 
                                   a project                            
  pause           [project]        Pause production traffic for a       
                                   project (visitors will see an error  
                                   page)                                
  observability   action [name]    Enable or disable Observability Plus 
                                   for a project                        
  resume          [project]        Resume production traffic for a      
                                   paused project                       
  update          [name]           Update one or more project settings; 
                                   omitted settings remain unchanged    
  rename          name new-name    Rename a project                     
  remove          name             Delete a project                     
  token           [name]           Get a development OIDC token for a   
                                   project                              


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default off)                          
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default off)                       
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts; when an agent is 
                              detected this is the default                      
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Pause production traffic for a project

    $ vercel project pause [NAME]
    $ vercel project pause my-project

  - Resume a paused project

    $ vercel project resume [NAME]
    $ vercel project resume my-project

  - Add a member to a project

    $ vercel project members add [NAME] <EMAIL | UID> --role <ROLE>
    $ vercel project members add my-project user@example.com --role PROJECT_VIEWER

  - Remove a member from a project

    $ vercel project members remove [NAME] <EMAIL | UID>
    $ vercel project members remove my-project user@example.com

  - Enable or disable Observability Plus for a project

    $ vercel project observability <enable | disable> [NAME]
    $ vercel project observability enable my-project

  - Enable Web Analytics for a project

    $ vercel project web-analytics [NAME]
    $ vercel project web-analytics my-project

  - Enable Speed Insights for a project

    $ vercel project speed-insights [NAME]
    $ vercel project speed-insights my-project
